feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 3 August 2026 11:47am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 03 August 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds for a time.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure will move towards Ireland, with associated frontal system moving into the Irish Sea tonight.


##Wind##

East or Southeast 4 or 5, soon decreasing 3 or 4 this afternoon. Veering South or Southeast in places this evening, then tonight soon increasing East or Southeast 4 or 5 in all waters and occasionally touching 6 in places, including parts of the Isle of Man. Veering South tomorrow morning and decreasing 3 or 4.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate tonight, falling slight later tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain tonight and tomorrow morning, mist and fog patches later tonight and tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor later, very poor in any fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South 3 or 4, increasing South or Southwest 4 or 5 during tomorrow afternoon and evening. Veering West 4 or 5 overnight into Wednesday, increasing 5 to 7 on Wednesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate on Wednesday morning, possibly moderate to rough by late morning.


##Weather##

Any mist and fog patches at first soon clearing to isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor at first, possibly very poor in any fog patches, but soon becoming good.
